user_query: show me open source AI tooling companies like Hugging Face

criteria.text: Provides open-source software (libraries, frameworks, or SDKs) for building, training, or deploying AI models
criteria.rationale: Hugging Face is primarily an open-source tooling provider; this separates true peers from companies that sell closed-source or purely hosted SaaS ML products.

criteria.text: Hosts or operates a public model repository or model hub that distributes pre-trained models under open-source or permissive licenses
criteria.rationale: A model hub or repository is a distinctive product that enables model discovery and reuse, distinguishing peers that act as community model platforms from tool vendors that do not publish models.

criteria.text: Targets developers and ML practitioners with developer-focused tooling such as SDKs, APIs, CLIs, or extensible plugins
criteria.rationale: Hugging Face serves technical users; this filters out non-developer-focused vendors (e.g., low-code/no-code business apps) even if they mention AI.

criteria.text: Enables training, fine-tuning, or deployment workflows for generative or foundation models (for example NLP, vision, or multimodal models)
criteria.rationale: Peer companies support the end-to-end model lifecycle for large/generative models, which differentiates them from companies that only provide peripheral services (e.g., data labeling or analytics).

criteria.text: Encourages or accepts community contributions such as user-submitted models, datasets, or model metadata
criteria.rationale: Community-driven contribution and sharing is a core differentiator for open-source AI tooling platforms versus proprietary toolchains that do not accept public contributions.
